blocks.raw: ## Create audience group using audience filters
blocks.text: Create audience group using audience filters

blocks.raw: Filters facilitate the effectiveness of a campaign by targeting the right customers in the right context. You can build an audience group based on specific information in a certain period. The information could be on behavior, interests, demographic details, transactions, and more. For example, you can get high spending customers that did not visit your stores for the last three months.
blocks.text: Filters facilitate the effectiveness of a campaign by targeting the right customers in the right context. You can build an audience group based on specific information in a certain period. The information could be on behavior, interests, demographic details, transactions, and more. For example, you can get high spending customers that did not visit your stores for the last three months.

blocks.raw: **With filters you can**:
blocks.text: With filters you can:

blocks.raw:
* Create  audience groups using various predefined filters such as transactions, customer details, demographics, custom field details, and loyalty information. Only users (user\_cf) and invoice (inv\_cf) custom fields are supported for filtering. Store custom fields (store\_cf) are visible in the filter options, but are not supported for filtering. For more information about audience filters, refer to **[About audience group filters](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/about-audience-group-filters)** documentation.
* Optimize a group using multiple filters to get a specific intended customer list. For example, you can build an audience group that purchased during Dec 1, 2021 - Jan 31, 2022 with marital status married.
* You can either use and/or operators between two filters.
* You can reuse an audience list in other campaigns.

blocks.raw:
Category Description
Loyalty Lets you build audience groups with loyalty behavior such as active points, expired points, redeemed points, current tier, registered store, registered date, demographic details, and tier migration.
Transaction Lets you build an audience group based on purchases, returns, and recently purchased products or categories. For more information, see [Transaction based filters](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/transaction-based-filters).
Campaigns & Coupons Lets you build an audience group based on the count of redeemed coupons, about to expire coupons, and the number of messages received, and more. For more information, see the [Campaigns & Coupons based filters](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/campaigns-coupons-based-filters) documentation.
User Profile Lets you build an audience group based on their demographic details, custom field details, subscription status, NDNC status, available communication channels, and more. - \*For more information, see [User Profile based filters](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/user-profile-based-filters)
Purchase pattern Lets you build an audience group based on their purchase behavior such as preferred shopping time, average transaction value, average basket value, top n customers, favorite products, and more. For more information, see [Purchase Pattern](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/purchase-patternbehavior-based-filters)
Zero power filters Lets you build an audience group with a specific prediction. When you combine zero-powered filters with standard filters, the chances are high to achieve a better hit rate, better incremental sales by offering relevant products to customers at the right time.
Behavioural event Lets you build an audience based on the behavioural vent of customers. For example, if you want to target users who has reviewed a product, you can filter the audience by adding the related behavioural event filter (eg: User review event)

blocks.raw:
<Callout icon="📘" theme="info">
  ### Notes

  - A filtered audience is refreshed during the daily ETL sync only when it is actively used by a running Journey. If the audience is not associated with an active Journey, it is not refreshed automatically. When a Journey becomes active and uses a previously inactive filtered audience, the initial execution uses the last refreshed audience. The audience is not refreshed immediately. Automatic refresh begins after the next EI sync, and subsequent Journey executions use the updated audience. You can enable **"Execute message only after audience sync completion"** to ensure that the campaign proceeds only after confirming ETL sync completion and verifying that the audience is up to date. For more information, refer to the <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/schedule-message#scheduling-messages-post-audience-sync-confirmation">documentation on the same</Anchor>.

  - To update the audience immediately, select** Refresh now.** The refresh typically completes within 10–15 minutes, after which the updated audience can be used in Journeys and campaigns. 


    <Image src="https://files.readme.io/590e9797860ba441c5eb48a215dc5a10e9de3ca732b7335cbad95fa3d187257f-image.png" align="left" width="50%" border={true} wrap={false} />


  - By default, the system tries to sync the required data about two hours before the campaign run time. If the sync is delayed or fails, data from two days ago may be used instead, and a banner appears in Insights indicating that syncing is still in progress.

  - Each condition you add using filters influences which customers qualify for campaigns that use this audience.
    - Using **AND** operator means a customer must satisfy all configured conditions to remain in the audience.
    - Using **OR** operator means a customer is included if they meet at least one of the conditions. These rules apply across all filter categories

      Example:
      If you configure the audience with:

      Active points ≥ 500 AND

      Expiry points ≥ 100

      then only customers who meet both conditions will be included. Customers who have points expiring but do not meet the minimum active-points requirement will be excluded.
    - Ensure that the audience sync is completed before executing a campaign. If the sync is delayed, eligible members may be excluded from the audience and may not receive the intended communication
</Callout>

blocks.raw: ## Create audience group using CSV file
blocks.text: Create audience group using CSV file

blocks.raw: If you have the customer list with you offline that you want to use to send campaigns, you can do it by creating and uploading the CSV file. Ensure that you upload the right identifiers according to the target channel. For example, if you want to send an SMS campaign, you need to have the CSV file with mobile numbers, for an email campaign, it should be email IDs and so on.
blocks.text: If you have the customer list with you offline that you want to use to send campaigns, you can do it by creating and uploading the CSV file. Ensure that you upload the right identifiers according to the target channel. For example, if you want to send an SMS campaign, you need to have the CSV file with mobile numbers, for an email campaign, it should be email IDs and so on.

blocks.raw:
<Callout icon="📘" theme="info">
  ### Note

  While uploading audience lists, if [dual eligibility ](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/customer_entity#dual-eligibility)is enabled for your organization, avoid using email addresses or mobile numbers, as these identifiers may not be unique. This is because multiple customers can share the same email or mobile number, which means the audience list may not work as expected.

  To ensure accurate audience creation, use unique identifiers such as `customer_external_id` or `user_id`.
</Callout>

blocks.raw:
<Callout icon="📘" theme="info">
  ### Notes

  - While uploading a CSV, an identifier tag is compulsory to include. Mobile, email, external id, and user id. The tags should be present in continuation. You can add a maximum of 15 custom tags
  - After clicking Confirm and upload, if the upload is taking a longer time, you may close it. The upload process will still continue in the background.
  - If an audience group is created using an uploaded CSV, the list will be static and not get refreshed.
  - While uploading a CSV file, ensure that it does not contain duplicate records. If duplicates are present, the system identifies them and retains only the unique entries.
  - Audience groups created from uploaded files should be refreshed or recreated periodically. Source files are retained for 2 years, after which the audience group may no longer be processed correctly. If you encounter issues while using an audience group in your campaign, recreate the audience group before scheduling the campaign.
</Callout>

You can choose how do you want to combine the two groups. Once selected, the audience groups are combined based on the chosen logic.
Below is the table that describes the possibility for combining the selected audience groups.

blocks.raw:
| Option                       | Description                                                                                                   |
| :--------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **All people**               | Includes all customers who belong to **Group 1 or Group 2** which is union of both groups.                    |
| **Only common people**       | Includes only customers who are present in **both Group 1 and Group 2** which is intersection of both groups. |
| **People in 1 but not in 2** | Includes customers who are present in **Group 1 but excluded from Group 2**.                                  |
| **People in 2 but not in 1** | Includes customers who are present in **Group 2 but excluded from Group 1**.                                  |

blocks.raw:
<Callout icon="📘" theme="info">
  ### Notes

  - **Combined audience lists remain static**

    When you create an audience filter by combining two or more existing groups, the resulting dataset remains static, it captures the customers from the selected audience groups at that point in time. Any changes made to the two or more parent groups afterwards will not be reflected in this new dataset.

    For instance, let's consider audience lists A and B. A includes elements 1, 2, and 3, while B includes elements 1, 2, 4, 5, and 6. If you create a new audience list C by selecting common elements from A and B, C will contain 1 and 2.

    However, even if you later update A to include elements 1, 2, 3, and 5, the changes will not impact C. C will continue to include only elements 1 and 2.
  - Refreshing a combined audience updates only the status of the customers already in the audience. It does not add or remove customers based on changes made to the source audience groups.
  - When combining audience groups, always update each audience list to ensure it contains the latest data. If an audience is not updated, the combined audience will be created using previously saved audience data.

    Example: If you create Audience list A on Day 1 and Audience list B on Day 3, and then combine them on Day 4 without updating either audience list, the combined audience will include customers based on the data captured when Audiences A and B were last updated, not the latest eligible customers.
  - Combined audience lists are static and do not auto-refresh during campaign execution. If a user's status changes (for example, to DELETION PENDING) after the last audience refresh, these changes will not be reflected in the campaign until you manually refresh the audience list. As a result, ineligible users may continue to receive communications until the audience is refreshed. To ensure your campaign targets only eligible users, refresh combined audience lists before sending or scheduling communications.
</Callout>

blocks.raw: ## Create audience group using import via FTP connector option
blocks.text: Create audience group using import via FTP connector option

blocks.raw: This option enables you to create the audience list using the imported audience file available on the FTP server, thus allowing you to fetch customer lists from an external source daily. This external source could be other than the Capillary database. By default, the system tries to sync the required data about two hours before the campaign run time. If the sync is delayed or fails, data from two days ago may be used instead, and a banner appears in Insights indicating that syncing is still in progress.

This external source could be other than the Capillary database. By default, the system tries to sync the required data about two hours before the campaign run time. If the sync is delayed or fails, data from two days ago may be used instead, and a banner appears in Insights indicating that syncing is still in progress.

blocks.raw:
<Callout icon="📘" theme="info">
  ### Important

  Campaigns that use FTP-uploaded audiences target only the users available in the latest successfully processed file at the time the campaign runs. If the FTP upload completes after the scheduled execution, the newly uploaded audience is included in the next campaign run. To ensure the intended audience is targeted, complete the FTP upload and processing before the scheduled campaign time.
</Callout>

blocks.raw:
1. From the **Unique identifier** drop-down, select the unique identifier. This should be the unique identifier available in the Databricks file.

2. In the Map fields section, map the fields to the FTP file.  For example, if column 1 in the file contains a user ID, select USER\_ID from the drop-down and map it against column 1.
   You must define the mapping for at least one column and you can map up to a maximum of 3 columns.

3. Make sure that the **Audience Reload from FTP** dataflow on Connect+ is configured. This is required to update the audience list as per a defined schedule. For information on this template, refer to the [Connect+ documentation](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/audience-reload-from-ftp).

4. Click Done.

   <Image src="https://files.readme.io/8a41d6f-Mapping_FTP_file.png" align="center" border={true} />

5. To check the details, click on the Audience group name. If the dataflow in Connect+ is not configured, an error message will be displayed in the details.
